title: styxx/8.0 prereg cert (spec section 7.2; kind noise-plan is section 5.1)

allOf.$comment: Section 5.1: a noise plan names R (the run count), the enumerated nuisance factors with their values, and the environment, and R is at least 5 (10 pairwise distances). R is REQUIRED here, not merely shaped: enforcing the minimum only when the key happens to be present made the whole of it optional, and a plan minted by hand with `runs` omitted fixed no R at all, which reopened the hand-picked-subset attack in full (papers/v8/challenge_and_attack_2026_09_09, F7; A-NORUNS in the third pass -- ten subsets of the lab's own five published runs appended with an empty floor_disagreement and topk floors from 0.81 to 2.14, flipping the published verdict word). The earlier note here said presence belonged at the mint (styxx/v8/cli.py) because a schema change must not turn a logged entry invalid; that trade is withdrawn. The mint is the one path an issuer holding the key does not use, so a check that lives only there checks nobody, and a prereg of kind noise-plan that fixes no R is not a plan a later floor may rest on -- it is a document shaped like one. The other two fields of step 1 (nuisance, environment) stay at the mint, because unlike R nothing downstream recomputes against them. styxx/v8/log.py _check_floor_names_the_plans_runs refuses the same thing from the other side, for a plan this schema never saw.
